facts.fact: WHO Gabon's 2025 annual report states that, following the national deployment of DHIS2 in 2024, the reporting completeness rate rose from 35% in 2024 to 40% in 2025; it gives no numerator or denominator and does not say which facilities report.

WHO Gabon reports that in 2025 it trained 25 DHIS2 experts as a technical team, 16 military health data managers to bring the defence sector into reporting, 5 system administrators and more than 30 logisticians on DHIS2 logistics indicators and dashboards.

WHO Gabon reports that the 5 DHIS2 system administrators it trained in 2025 on servers, security and maintenance belong to ANINF and the Ministry of Health; the document does not otherwise name who owns or hosts the system.

WHO Gabon states that after the 2024 national deployment of DHIS2 it directed its 2025 support to strengthening the health information system (data quality, reporting completeness and timeliness), training more than 76 professionals; no domestic budget line for the system is mentioned.

note: DHIS2 is classed hmis because the document ties it to routine reporting completeness and timeliness; it names no module. The completeness figure is the document's only coverage-like number and is not a share of clinics, so no clinics, tiers or digitised fact is taken. The owner:ministry row rests only on the administrators' affiliation, which the parent may judge too thin.
